title: Bruno Mars’ ‘Romantic Tour’ Expands With 2027 Dates In Asia, Australia
summary: The R&B star announces 27 new stadium shows across the region in 2027, and adds a fifth Mexico City later this year.
contentText:
Bruno Mars will get romantic will fans next year across Asia, Australia and New Zealand.

The R&B star announces 27 new stadium shows across the region in 2027, and adds a fifth Mexico City later this year, “due to overwhelming demand,” notes the tour promoter Live Nation.  

Announced Thursday, Aug. 27, the new run follows previously-announced shows in Japan in January. Mars’ latest tour down under will get underway Feb. 13, 2027 at Optus Stadium in Perth, and heads east for multiple nights in Melbourne, Brisbane, Sydney, and Auckland, before returning to Asia with four nights at Singapore’s National Stadium, starting April 13.

Two-time Grammy Award-winning singer and songwriter Tyla will join Mars as special guest on all AU/NZ shows, while his nine-time Grammy winner and Silk Sonic collaborator Anderson .Paak  will perform as DJ Pee .Wee on all newly announced shows.

Before that run, Mars’ fans in Mexico will get a fifth concert in the capital at Estadio GNP Seguros, booked for Friday, Dec. 11.

With the announcement,  The Romantic Tour  now spans more than 115 stadium shows across North America, Europe, the United Kingdom, Asia, Australia, New Zealand, and Mexico, including six nights at London’s Wembley Stadium; and five nights each at Rogers Stadium in Toronto, SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles, and BC Place in Vancouver.

The tour is in support of Mars’ fourth studio album, The Romantic , which debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 in March of this year. Mars last led the tally with his second full-length studio album,  Unorthodox Jukebox , which climbed to No. 1 in March 2013, nearly three months after its release. The Romantic  is Mars’ first No. 1-debuting album on the all-genres U.S. chart, and his fifth top 10 appearance, including An Evening With Silk Sonic, which went to No. 2 in 2021.

In Australia, The Romantic opened at No. 2 on the ARIA Chart, extending his unbroken streak of top 5 albums (including a three week stint at No. 1 with Unorthodox Jukebox ).

Visit  BrunoMars.com  for ticket information.
